title: PH2T-splines, Part I: A Reasonable Mesh Assumption
summary: This paper is the first in a three-part series on the construction of polynomial splines with the highest order of smoothness over hierarchical T-meshes, referred to as $\PHtwoT$-splines. For splines of bi-degree $(d,d)$, we study suitable refinement conditions for the subsequent basis construction, which requires dimensional stability of the underlying spline space. We present two groups of examples, considering unrestricted hierarchical refinement and refinement without vanishable T $l$-edges, respectively.
